metadata.description: Personal Claude Code agents, one independent plugin per agent, each with its own skills

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: git-workflow-manager agent: commit, push, PR, CI, merge, release, conflicts

plugins.name: sql
plugins.description: sql-pro agent: queries, schema design, tuning, migrations, database setup

plugins.name: db-performance
plugins.description: database-optimizer agent: workload analysis, index strategy, read-only health checks

plugins.name: frontend
plugins.description: frontend-developer agent: new apps, components, data fetching, accessibility, performance

plugins.name: playwright
plugins.description: frontend-tester agent: Playwright setup, write tests, run tests, debug failures. MCP server included.

plugins.name: backend
plugins.description: backend-developer agent: endpoints, use-case logic, validation, service hardening

plugins.name: node
plugins.description: node-specialist agent: Node.js performance and runtime-level code review

plugins.name: typescript
plugins.description: typescript-pro agent: type design and incremental JavaScript to TypeScript migration

plugins.name: api
plugins.description: api-designer agent: API design, OpenAPI specs, breaking-change review

plugins.name: architecture
plugins.description: architect-reviewer agent: read-only design reviews and decision records

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: code-reviewer agent: read-only change and security reviews

plugins.name: testing
plugins.description: test-automator agent: unit, integration and API tests, flaky tests, coverage gaps

plugins.name: payments
plugins.description: payment-integration agent: provider integration, webhooks, payment security review (test mode only)

plugins.name: email
plugins.description: email-deliverability-engineer agent: SPF/DKIM/DMARC, transactional email code, deliverability audits

plugins.name: dependencies
plugins.description: dependency-manager agent: dependency audits and safe upgrades

plugins.name: docs
plugins.description: documentation-engineer agent: write docs and keep them in sync with code

plugins.name: devops
plugins.description: devops-engineer agent: CI pipelines, Dockerfiles, docker-compose

plugins.name: agent-installer
plugins.description: agent-installer agent: browse, vet and install community agents
